Heliolisk 1.2.0

  theme/          heliolisk.zip - upload in Appearance > Themes > Add New > Upload Theme
  plugins/        heliolisk-core.zip - companion plugin (also bundled in the theme)
  demo-data/      demo-import.zip - demo content, Customizer settings and widgets
  documentation/  open index.html in a browser
  licensing/      licenses and credits of third-party resources
